note: Bar (fill) colour of the circle counter: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/visual-builder/packages/module-library/src/components/circle-counter/module.json attributes.circle.settings.advanced.circle fields.color, attrName circle.advanced.color (default the site primary colour gcid-primary-color); Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/ModuleLibrary/CircleCounter/CircleCounterModule.php:522 passes it to the front-end script as barColor, and the easyPieChart script draws it on the counter canvas. No CSS shows it, so the probe compares the canvas pixels (canvas: true).

Track (the unfilled ring) colour: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/visual-builder/packages/module-library/src/components/circle-counter/module.json fields Circle Background Color, attrName circle.advanced.background (value.color; empty by default, the track then takes the bar colour); Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/ModuleLibrary/CircleCounter/CircleCounterModule.php:523 passes it as trackColor, drawn on the canvas at the track opacity (default 0.1). Compared by canvas pixels.

Track opacity: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/visual-builder/packages/module-library/src/components/circle-counter/module.json field Circle Background Opacity, attrName circle.advanced.background (value.opacity, default 0.1); Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/ModuleLibrary/CircleCounter/CircleCounterModule.php:524 passes it as trackAlpha. Compared by canvas pixels (the track pixels change alpha). The base sets a track colour (#ff3b00): a first run with no track colour in the base measured no change (DEAD), so the opacity is taught only together with a colour.

Percent sign after the number: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/visual-builder/packages/module-library/src/components/circle-counter/module.json attributes.number.settings.advanced.percentSign, attrName number.advanced.percentSign (default on); Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/ModuleLibrary/CircleCounter/CircleCounterModule.php:731 prints the % sign only when it is on. A change of WHAT is printed, so the probe compares the rendered text (text: true). Not the number counter's enablePercentSign.
